shortDescription: Kenya's competition regulator has approved Diageo's LSE:DGE sale of its 65% stake in East African Breweries Plc NSEKE:EABL to Asahi Group Holdings TSE:2502, subject to conditions, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing a letter.
